title: W2 병렬 가지의 폭·깊이를 원본 backbone과 같게 줄인 C2MS
hypothesis: The W2 branch of C2MS keeps PixelUnshuffle(2)/PixelShuffle(2) but runs 8 blocks at 128 channels (2.43M of the 2.85M parameters). If the gain of C2MS over the original comes mainly from processing at half resolution with the four sub-pixel positions mixed, a branch whose inside equals the original backbone pipeline (four 64-channel conv-ReLU-conv residual blocks between 1x1 projections 256->64 and 64->256, 0.33M) keeps most of the gain with a 0.76M model.

evidence.experiment_29: W3 (eight 64-channel blocks at full resolution) RR +0.643 dB vs W2 (unshuffle, 128 channels) +0.723 dB against the original, seed 42
evidence.experiment_72: 87.3% of the C2MS gain over the original sits at periods under 8 px
evidence.experiment_73: QB models above C2MS are 0.6M; longer or faster training of C2MS did not improve QB test

arms.C2MS_M: C2MS with the W2 branch PixelUnshuffle(2) -> 1x1 256->64 -> 4 x [3x3 conv, ReLU, 3x3 conv, skip] at 64 channels -> 1x1 64->256 (zero init) -> PixelShuffle(2), added to the original backbone output; everything else (stem, conv64t48, three SSA stages, scale-mixed training) as C2MS

comparisons.official: C2MS_M against the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed (criteria v2.4, RR only)
comparisons.retention: share of the C2MS RR PSNR gain over the original 43 C0 kept by C2MS_M

control_policy: No new control run: the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed is the official control and the 57 retrained C2MS shows run-to-run variation.

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.4: RR PSNR, SAM, ERGAS against the same-seed 53 C2MS; single seed noise threshold 0.06 dB; FR QNR/D_lambda/D_s reference only
judgement.reported: validation PSNR/SAM per epoch, RR against 53, 57 and the original, share of the C2MS gain kept, FR QNR reference

stages.reading: improvement over 53 C2MS is not expected with 1/7 of the branch; the result reports the v2.4 label against 53 and the share of the gain kept against the original
stages.next: seeds 43/44 or GF2/WV3 only after user approval

limits: capacity and structure change together: width 128 -> 64 and depth 8 -> 4
expected_duration: about 3 h on the RTX 3060 Ti (53 C2MS needed about 3 h for 150 epochs; the branch is 1/7 of the W2 cost)
precision: FP16 AMP core training with GradScaler; FP32 transforms, loss, validation and evaluation (as 53/63)
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch 0, earliest exact tie; test never used for selection (same rule as 53/63)
